title: Hussain Sab Teri
body:
hussain sab teri qurbaniyo ka sadqa hai
ke aaj tak dile insaniyat dhadakta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame hussain mein aansu phir uske baad iram
khareed lo ke ye sauda bahot hi sasta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
mubahile ki ye soorat bata rahi hai hamein
ke panjetan ke muqabil jo aaye jhoota hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussainiyat ko lahoo chahiye baqa ke liye
yazeediyat ne phir ek baar sar ubhara hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
usay hussain se nisbat na do khuda ke liye
jo maslehat se ghame sheh mein kaam leta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kya jawaaz e sitam ay zameene karbobala
ke teen roz se mehmaan tera pyasa hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
elaahi khair kisi ki nazar na lag jaye
zaeef baap ka kadiyal jawan beta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
jise hussain ne athara saal paala tha
zameen e garm pe wo aediya ragad'ta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
khudara isko tamache na maar ay zaalim
ye bachi gham ki satayi hui sakina hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
na loot chadare zainab na cheen sar se rida
ye binte zehra hai zaalim ye binte zehra hai
hussain sab teri…
